[SWS_SM_00706] IAM check
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
S2R Hub
shall verify during the
ara::sm::s2r::S2RHub::S2RHub
constructor
that the current
Process
context matches the mapped
SuspendToRamHubMapping
.
process
. In case not, the Violation
InsufficientPermissionsViolation
and
the SecurityEvent
SEV_ACCESS_CONTROL_SM_IAM_ACCESS_DENIED
shall be trig-
gered.
⌋
